description.value: Acharya Daiko Store Ltd. is British Columbia's first Nepali grocery store, established in 2023 on Kingsway in Vancouver. It specializes in authentic Nepali food products — noodles, spices, snacks, dry goods, frozen items — as well as traditional kitchenware and cultural gifts. The store serves both the local Nepali community and anyone curious about South Asian flavours, and also offers online ordering with Metro Vancouver delivery and Canada-wide shipping.
